summary: Implemented the Tabs widget feature in the Textual repo, but nothing has been run: all work was done by reading and editing files, as instructed. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs, with __all__ = ["Tab", "Tabs"]); UnderlineBar gains clickable_ranges before width, attaching range_clicked('<name>') @click metadata per cell, with the original path unchanged when no ranges are given; Opacity now merges only the blended foreground into each segment's existing style, preserving click metadata; no layout resolver change was needed because min_size (default 1) already exists in the edge protocol and is honored. Added a required underline test (test_clickable_ranges_attach_click_action_to_spans, using a raw rich Console because the string render helper cannot show metadata), a new tests/test_tabs.py, docs/reference/tabs.md (single directive), and a sandbox demo (tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css). Existing tests were not modified. Design choices: padding is resolved through layout_resolve over padding edges only, avoiding the size-or-None quirk for empty labels and tab_padding=0; no-tabs draws only the bar; the watcher skips animation when the old name is empty, so the bar starts at the active index; find_tab_by_name returns the last matching index, which can disagree with the de-duplicated render list when names collide; name is an extra optional trailing constructor keyword. Unverified risks: Rich Style meta merging under +, which Opacity and click metadata depend on, and the watcher argument count. Nothing was committed.
